_comment: Canonical participant metadata for all paper figures. `initials` is the internal key used in data pkls / result dirs; `display_id` is the ONLY identifier that may appear in published figures, source-data tables, and captions. `color` is the participant's fixed plotting colour — the SAME colour must be used for a participant in every figure/panel/legend. Add a row (with a distinct colour) when a new participant enters the paper. Keep this file the single source of truth (see README.md).
